tools.name: RoseScan
tools.description: Lightweight network discovery and service fingerprinting scanner with passive mode, CVE hints, and clean JSON/CSV export. Ideal for fast internal asset mapping.

tools.name: CipherDump
tools.description: Memory and disk forensics collector that grabs volatile artifacts, process trees, and open network handles before the box gets powered off. Ships with a triage report generator.

tools.name: N0VA — Adversary Framework
tools.description: Modular C2 and adversary simulation framework with encrypted comms, operator console, and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped payload builders. Includes full documentation and lab environment.

tools.name: AuthForge
tools.description: Automated authentication and authorization tester — session handling, JWT pitfalls, SSO misconfigs, and OAuth flow abuse, all in one repeatable test pack.
